'''Matare''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Matare was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Matare returned to the ancestral Jedi homeworld [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] with the rest of the Order and helped rebuild during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kaldona]], Matare was uneasy near the ruins of the ancient fortress city of [[Kaleth]] as he sensed the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] permeating the crumbling stones.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
There are two Matares in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' both on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]&mdash;a [[Matare (Zabrak)|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] at the [[Masters' Retreat]], and a human Padawan near the ruins of [[Kaleth]].
